title: Delivery Tariff for the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
This tariff fixes the delivery charges each programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carries: the order value at or above which delivery is carried, the charge on an order under it, the charge for splitting one order across two fields or two delivery days, and the charge for a delivery taken outside plant hours.

| Programme | Minimum order (USD) | Charge under the minimum (USD) | Split load (USD) | After hours (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 500 | 75 | 45 | 120 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 500 | 75 | 45 | 120 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 750 | 50 | 45 | 120 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 750 | 50 | 45 | 120 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 90 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Minimum order.** The minimum order is the order value at or above which delivery is carried without the under-minimum charge: 500 USD on the two entry programmes and 750 USD on the Seasonal Terms and Early Pay programmes. The Full Acre Input Financing Account and the Precision Partner Input Program Account carry no minimum, and accordingly no charge under it.

**Split load.** Splitting one order across two fields or two delivery days carries 45 USD on the four programmes that show it, and nothing on the two whole-farm programmes.

**After hours.** A delivery taken outside plant hours carries 120 USD up to the Early Pay Prepay Program Account, 90 USD on the Full Acre Input Financing Account, and nothing on the Precision Partner Input Program Account.

*Hypothetical reading.* An order of 640 USD on the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account sits under that programme's 750 USD minimum and carries the 50 USD charge; the same order on the Standard 30-Day Charge Account is above that programme's 500 USD minimum and carries nothing.
